# Offline residential IPv6 campaign toolkit (interface v3)

`campaign.py` is the only scored entry point: one UTF-8 JSON campaign object on
stdin, one UTF-8 JSON result object on stdout, diagnostics on stderr, exit zero.
Everything is an offline evidence model over `2001:db8::/32` — no target is ever
contacted and no packet is transmitted.

```
python3 -I -B campaign.py < campaign.json
```

Under `-I` the script directory and the sibling read-only dependency tree are
absent from `sys.path`, so `campaign.py` re-adds both (`../deps` holds the
pinned CPython 3.11 zstandard/NetworkX wheels installed by `../bootstrap.py`).

## Module map

| file | responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `common.py` | identifier, address, prefix, quota-forest and whole-document metadata validation; `Invalid` vs `CaptureError` |
| `gen_targets.py` | lease expansion: deterministic canary IID plus low IIDs, probe table, planned low sets (legacy CLI emits a plain target file) |
| `classify_responses.py` | capture transport: base64 chunks, Zstandard frame walk, byte/record budgets, logical CSV records (legacy CLI groups ZMap6 output by /64) |
| `ledger.py` | typed record parsing and the revision-aware publication index |
| `census.py` | lease state (inactive/alias/conflict/usable), causal internal/external roles, application service census, request activity |
| `protocols.py` | ADB and usbmuxd/sync open-payload signatures and the probe-script certificate |
| `planning.py` | quota-constrained follow-up plan as a min-cost maximum flow |

## Semantics worth remembering

* Record identity is `(type, id)` globally; the highest revision published at or
  before a query wins, identical semantic contents collapse (address, decimal and
  base64 spellings are irrelevant) and two distinct contents conflict forever.
* Prefix leases scope evidence: nothing is ever joined across leases, even when
  two leases plan the same address.  A positive canary self echo quarantines the
  whole lease; an address that is both internal and external quarantines the
  lease too, and quarantined leases expose empty clean role sets.
* An application row only counts when its lease is usable, its target holds a
  clean role, and that role's earliest causal witness is not later than the row's
  event.  Only maximum-attempt rows decide open/closed/unknown.
* The plan maximises assignments first and minimises the summed offer cost
  second; assignments are sorted by request ID and each carries a semantic
  certificate (TCP empty, ADB CNXN+CLSE, sync two GetValue frames).

Legacy CLIs remain available as development tools; they do not define version 3
behaviour.  `python3 /workspace/public_check.py /workspace/submission` runs the
public sanity fixtures.
